# LinkedIn Outreach {#sec-outreach}

::: {.callout-warning appearance="minimal"}
**Awaiting extended `apply-hm-enricher`** (planned for 0.3).

When a hiring manager is named (LinkedIn post author, JD signature, or explicit `--hm` flag), the extended `apply-hm-enricher` writes `.apply-state/outreach-snippets.md` with two artifacts:

- A LinkedIn connection-request note (≤300 characters)
- A post-connection InMail message (~180 words) referencing specific HM signals

When no HM is named, this section recommends portal-only application and suggests the public-engagement fallback (e.g., a LinkedIn post about a relevant project).

Run `jobsmith assemble {{< var slug >}}` after the specialist writes its output to populate this section.
:::
